column1: # Simplified Chinese (zh-hans: zh-CN, zh-SG, zh-Hans, zh) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (the context column is always empty here).
# Kition Film's own catalog: the upstream editor ships none for Chinese. It covers every label the
# web editor draws through `phrase()` (web/parity/i18n.mjs and the flow test check that). Terms
# follow the Simplified Chinese vocabulary video editors use in Adobe Premiere Pro (源, 节目, 项目,
# 素材箱, 效果控件, 音频剪辑混合器, 播放指示器…), written from the plain meaning of each
# English label; no proprietary localisation resource or string table was copied. Keyboard
# shortcuts, units (px, fps, dB, Hz), `{name}` placeholders, and product and format names
# (Kition Film, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) stay as they are.
# Glossary, applied everywhere (Premiere Pro's Simplified Chinese terms):
#   Source 源 · Program 节目 · Project 项目 · Bin 素材箱 · Sequence 序列 · Clip 剪辑 · Track 轨道
#   Timeline 时间轴 · Playhead 播放指示器 · In/Out Point 入点/出点 · Marker 标记
#   Effect Controls 效果控件 · Effects 效果 · Audio Clip Mixer 音频剪辑混合器
#   Audio Track Mixer 音频轨道混合器 · Metadata 元数据 · Properties 属性 · Graphics Templates 图形模板
#   Audio Mixing 音频混合 · Text 文本 · Media Browser 媒体浏览器 · Libraries 库 · Info 信息
#   History 历史记录 · Tools 工具 · Audio Meters 音频仪表 · Color 颜色 · Scopes 示波器 · Mix 混合
#   Workspaces: Editing 编辑 · Assembly 组件 · Color 颜色 · Audio 音频 · Captions and Graphics 字幕和图形
#   · Learning 学习 · Review 审阅 · All Panels 所有面板
#   Tools: Selection 选择 · Ripple Edit 波纹编辑 · Rolling Edit 滚动编辑 · Rate Stretch 比率拉伸
#   · Razor 剃刀 · Slip 外滑 · Slide 内滑 · Pen 钢笔 · Hand 手形 · Type 文字
#   Edits: Nest 嵌套 · Subclip 子剪辑 · Frame Hold 帧定格 · Lift 提升 · Extract 提取 · Insert 插入
#   · Overwrite 覆盖 · Ripple Delete 波纹删除 · Offline 脱机 · Proxy 代理 · Interpret Footage 解释素材
#   · Safe Areas 安全区域 · Guides 参考线 · Undo 撤消 · OK 确定 · Cancel 取消 · "{name} - Edited" "{name} - 已编辑"
# Names stored in a document (Video 1, Sequence 01) are not labels: they stay as stored, as upstream draws them.
